title: NLTK: Uncontrolled recursion in WordNet Synset hypernym walkers…
description: NLTK versions prior to 3.10.4 contain a vulnerability in four hypernym-walking methods of the WordNet Synset class that perform recursive graph traversal without cycle detection or depth limits. An attacker who can supply a malicious WordNet corpus file with cyclic or excessively deep hypernym pointer graphs can cause these methods to recurse indefinitely, resulting in a RecursionError that aborts the traversal and potentially crashes the application process. This vulnerability impacts availability only and requires no special privileges beyond loading attacker-controlled corpus data. The issue is fixed in NLTK version 3.10.4.
